name: Jarvis Bridge Tool
description: Sixteen fixed tools that proxy to the local Jarvis Bridge at 127.0.0.1:27901. Seven legacy probes + two whitelisted program tools (Phase 3A-3) plus nine Phase 2B worker tools for the Windows Runner Job API (submit, status, cancel, result), authorization (request, approve) and worker control (status, emergency_stop, resume). Worker operations: archive.list, archive.create (backend=direct only) and Codex (backend=codex, requires authorization).
